Technology Disruption Index

A reproducible proxy signal of technology-disruption exposure for SEC-registered public companies, combining patent activity and startup-ecosystem activity in each company's technology domains. It is a measurable signal, not a measurement of "true" disruption. Scores are 0-100.

Does the index predict outcomes? (year FE, t → t+1)

Coefficients per 10 index points, SEs clustered by company. Predictive associations, not causal effects. Green = p < 0.05.

Limitations. Patent data currently cover very few firms, so for most companies the index equals the startup-ecosystem component, which is an industry-level exposure measure. Universe = today's listed companies (survivorship bias). "Coverage" flags show where data are missing; missing is never treated as zero. Full methodology in the project README.
